_comment: Windows version-info resource for guard.exe, compiled to resource_windows.syso by goversioninfo and linked automatically by `go build`. Giving the unsigned binary a real publisher name + description lowers antivirus heuristic false positives and populates the file's Properties -> Details tab. See docs/signing.md. Version numbers: build.ps1 overrides FixedFileInfo.FileVersion (-ver-*) and both StringFileInfo version strings (-file-version, -product-version) from the repo-root VERSION file, but NOT FixedFileInfo.ProductVersion - goversioninfo has -product-ver-* flags for that and build.ps1 does not pass them. So keep ProductVersion below in step with VERSION by hand, or teach build.ps1 the four flags and make it a default like the rest.

StringFileInfo.FileDescription: Ward - parental control and content blocking service
